The *Nerayikaggiuṇhabhāvapañha* ("The Question on the Fires of Hell", Mil 3.4.6) is a dialogue in the *Milindapañha*. Modern translations include an English translation by John Kelly, alongside versions in other modern languages.

A full Chinese parallel to this discourse is preserved in the Chinese translation of the *Milindapañha* tradition as T 1670b 2.40 ("The Force of Karma").
